description.zh: 运筹帷幄之中，决胜千里之外——以历史为镜，问策于数据。覆盖 A 股/期货数据获取、量化策略编写（双均线/网格/突破/事件驱动/多因子）、回测引擎执行与专业回测报告（胜率/收益率/夏普比率/最大回撤）。策略是否可行，回测见真章。
description.en: Plan within the tent, win beyond the field — use history as the mirror and ask the data for strategy. Covers A-share/futures data, quant strategy coding (MA-cross, grid, breakout, event-driven, multi-factor), backtesting engines, and professional reports (win rate, returns, Sharpe, max drawdown).

welcome_message.zh: 在下问策——量化回测军师。策略灵不灵，不靠感觉靠数据。说出你的想法，我以历史为镜，为你验证成色。
welcome_message.en: I am WenCe, your quant backtesting strategist. Don't trust gut feelings — trust the data. Tell me your idea, and I'll test it against history.

description.zh: 双均线/网格/突破策略历史验证
description.en: Backtest MA-cross, grid, or breakout strategies

prompt.zh: 请对 510300 用双均线策略（MA5/MA20 金叉死叉）做近三年回测，输出胜率、年化收益率、夏普比率、最大回撤与资金曲线。
prompt.en: Backtest a MA5/MA20 cross strategy on 510300 over 3 years: win rate, annualized return, Sharpe, max drawdown, and equity curve.

description.zh: 因子模型构建与组合回测
description.en: Build and backtest a multi-factor model

prompt.zh: 请构建一个多因子选股模型（价值+动量+质量因子），对 A 股全市场做分层回测，输出各分层表现与因子有效性分析。
prompt.en: Build a multi-factor model (value+momentum+quality), run layered backtests on A-shares, and report layer performance and factor validity.

description.zh: 参数敏感性分析与过拟合警示

prompt.zh: 请对我现有策略做参数敏感性分析：哪些参数是过拟合风险点？样本外表现如何验证？
prompt.en: Run parameter sensitivity analysis on my strategy: which params risk overfitting, and how to validate out-of-sample?

description.zh: 回测指标的通俗解读与陷阱提示
description.en: Plain-language read of backtest metrics and pitfalls

prompt.zh: 我的回测报告显示年化 40%、夏普 2.1，请帮我评估：这个结果可信吗？有哪些常见的回测陷阱需要排查？
prompt.en: My backtest shows 40% annualized and Sharpe 2.1 — is it credible? What common backtesting traps should I check?
